flux2-storybook.label: FLUX.2 nostalgic storybook
flux2-storybook.sceneTemplate: Illustrate this exact story beat as one clear emotional moment: {{line}}. Use a recurring contemporary adult protagonist and include a second adult only when the narration clearly involves another person. Let gender, relationship, clothing, location, and action follow the script rather than forcing a fantasy character. Show believable simplified anatomy, expressive posture, and a readable human gesture; faces may appear in profile, three-quarter view, or soft shadow with minimal features. Visual anchors: {{keywords}}. Choose the framing that best tells the beat: an expansive landscape for loneliness or distance, a medium two-person composition for connection, or an intimate close view for a turning point. Build the vertical frame from a few large graphic shapes, a strong horizon or architectural anchor, generous open atmosphere, and an uncluttered band of negative space through the middle.
flux2-storybook.stylePrompt: Nostalgic hand-drawn romance storybook frame from an independent animated short. Bold dark ink contours, loose pencil hatching, simplified expressive people, matte flat color blocks, restrained cel shading, visible paper tooth, subtle halftone and aged film speckles, slightly imperfect print registration, and a handmade screen-printed finish. Muted autumn palette of burnt orange, rust, ochre, warm cream, moss green, dusty teal, faded denim blue, deep navy, and soft charcoal. Quiet poetic visual storytelling, ordinary contemporary clothes, emotionally legible body language, large skies and simple landscapes, warm melancholy, intimate human scale, and a vertical editorial composition. Keep all surfaces wordless and unbranded.
